share.doc: Public-safe preview facts for an External link (Secure share) token, used to draw the link card in chat. A public share (no email or password gate) returns its file name, filetype and sender; a gated share returns only state secure; a revoked, expired or unknown token returns state unavailable. Never returns hub ids, node ids, emails or gate details.

token.doc: Secure share token, the last segment of the External link

filename.doc: Shared file or folder name. public only

sender.doc: Full name of the person who created the link. public only
